content.name: Expertise
entries: At 1st level, choose two of your skill proficiencies, or one of your skill proficiencies and your proficiency with {@item thieves' tools|srd51}. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.
At 6th level, you can choose two more of your proficiencies (in skills or with {@item thieves' tools|srd51}) to gain this benefit.

content.name: Expertise
entries: You gain {@variantrule Expertise|SRD52} in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice. {@skill Sleight of Hand|SRD52} and {@skill Stealth|SRD52} are recommended if you have proficiency in them.
At Rogue level 6, you gain {@variantrule Expertise|SRD52} in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.
